scenicChapters.title: Romania Transalpina
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 44 km this is Romania Transalpina, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-voislova-gara-cfr-voineasa-crac-g.story: A 299 km round trip from Zăvoi - roughly 5 h 09 in the saddle. It goes by way of Sarmizegetusa - Colonia Ulpia Traiana Augu, Pui - Dealul Robului 1 and 2, Cugir - Bătrâna and Voineasa - Crac-Găuri. The highest point is about 1,600 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
